description: Home Mini Candle Trio Skip to the end of the images gallery Skip to the beginning of the images gallery AERIN Mini Candle Trio Add to Saved Items $250 Aerin's Love Quantity Availability: In Stock Add to Bag Select Gift Registry Add to Registry Description Presented in a branded gift box ready to give, three of AERIN's bestselling floral candles are now available in compact sizes in gold-rimmed ceramic vessels. Inspired by the island of Mustique, L'Ansecoy Orange Blossom offers sun-kissed orange blossom and sweet Cedar enhanced by the greens and citrus of Petitgrain. Uzes Tuberose captures the medieval town of Uzes in southern France with Tuberose, fruity Apricot, and a hint of spicy Clove. Monserrate Rose is a romantic pairing of Rose Centifolia and sparkling Gardenia enhanced by alluring Sandalwood, inspired by Portugal's Monserrate Palace and gardens. Details Ceramic 2.9 oz each Vessel dimensions: 2.4" x 2.7" Gift box dimensions: 9.1" X 3.1" X 3.4" Burn time: approximately 24 hours Scents include: L'Ansecoy Orange Blossom, Uzes Tuberose, Monserrate Rose Imported
